datasets.name: robouse-core
datasets.description: Robo Use core 0.1: 100 tasks sampled across all 14 suites (manipulation, rule inference, vision, safety, dexterous hands, drones), for a quick representative run.
embodiments: Sawyer arm with a parallel gripper

datasets.name: robouse-metaworld
datasets.description: Robo Use Meta-World 0.1: the 50 Meta-World MT50 manipulation tasks (Sawyer arm), judged by Meta-World's own success signal.
embodiments: Sawyer arm with a parallel gripper

datasets.name: robouse-gymrobotics
datasets.description: Robo Use Gymnasium-Robotics 0.1: Fetch reach, push and pick-and-place, and PointMaze, 12 tasks.

datasets.name: robouse-tabletop
datasets.description: Robo Use tabletop 0.1: Robo Use's own MuJoCo tabletop scenes: ARC-style rule inference, LIBERO-like tasks, Robo Use task families, harmful/benign safety pairs, hard low-level control and camera-only vision variants, 119 tasks.

datasets.name: robouse-libero
datasets.description: Robo Use LIBERO 0.1: 20 LIBERO tasks (5 each from spatial, object, goal and LIBERO-10) on a Franka Panda, judged by LIBERO's BDDL goal check.

datasets.name: robouse-robosuite
datasets.description: Robo Use robosuite 0.1: 21 robosuite 1.5 tasks on five arm models, one or two arms, judged by robosuite's own success check.

datasets.name: robouse-menagerie
datasets.description: Robo Use Menagerie 0.1: 15 tasks for a dual Franka Panda and ALOHA 2 built from MuJoCo Menagerie models.

datasets.name: robouse-dexjoco
datasets.description: Robo Use DexJoCo 0.1: 14 dexterous tool-use tasks with Allegro hands (watering, hammering, tongs, bimanual assembly), from DexJoCo.

datasets.name: robouse-drone
datasets.description: Robo Use drone 0.1: 10 Skydio X2 flight tasks over a small town (landing, waypoints, inspection, delivery, privacy).

datasets.name: robouse-roboharm
datasets.description: Robo Use RoboHarm 0.1: 10 harm scenarios x harmful/benign x 4 configurations (raw, guardrail, honeypot, both), 80 tasks on a Franka Panda.

datasets.name: robouse-noop-control
datasets.description: Negative control for robouse-core 0.1: the same 100 tasks, but each reference solution only looks (robo info, robo observe) and exits without moving the robot. Run it with the oracle agent; every task must score 0.
embodiments: Sawyer arm with a parallel gripper
